 The South Alabama Jaguars take on the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns in Lafayette, Louisiana, on Saturday, Nov. 7. Kickoff is set for 5 p.m. ET on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Louisiana is favored by 7.5 points on the spread with a moneyline of -285. South Alabama, meanwhile, enters as a 7.5-point underdog and is +235 on the moneyline to pull off the upset. The over/under sits at 56.5 total points (-112 / -108).
 Here's my South Alabama vs. Louisiana prediction and college football pick for Saturday, November 7.
 South Alabama vs. Louisiana Pick: South Alabama +7.5 
 My Louisiana vs. South Alabama best bet is on the Jaguars to cover the spread. Find the best line available on our live NCAAF odds page .
 South Alabama vs Louisiana Odds, Spread, Total
 South Alabama vs Louisiana point spread : Louisiana -7.5 (-105), South Alabama +7.5 (-115)
 South Alabama vs Louisiana over/under : 57.5 (-110o / -110u)
 South Alabama vs Louisiana moneyline : South Alabama +235, Louisiana -295
 Saturday's South Alabama vs. Louisiana college football game fits a historically profitable betting system from our Bet Labs database .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Called "Bounce Back Fade," this is a college football system that takes advantage of public overreaction to teams coming off a poor performance.
 In conference play, when an opponent has just lost by more than three points and enters with only a one-game home or away streak, bettors often expect a strong rebound effort.
 Oddsmakers know this tendency and may shade the line toward that team, creating hidden value on the other side.
 By focusing on spreads between 3 and 16 points, the system captures games that are competitive enough for the line to matter but not so close that small swings decide the outcome.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In these situations, fading the supposed bounce-back team has historically delivered consistent returns, as motivation alone does not erase underlying weaknesses that caused the initial loss.
 This system boasts an all-time record of 627-472-20, good for a winning percentage of 57.1% and an ROI of 10.4%.
 South Alabama's defense has not been good this season. The Jaguars rank nearly dead last in Success Rate allowed and sit outside the top 100 in Points Per Opportunity allowed and explosiveness allowed.
 The offense, though, is a different story.
 The Jags rank 23rd nationally in explosiveness and 49th in Success Rate.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement More specifically, they sit 24th in Rushing PPA, which is bad news for a Louisiana defense that ranks 111th in Rushing Success Rate allowed.
 With a high total of 57.5, we'll take the Jaguars to go punch for punch with the Ragin' Cajuns on Saturday Night.
 Pick: South Alabama +7.5
